STORE_CONTRACT.CLEANUP_POLICY: Separate explicit disposal authority only, never deletes/reset to enable grant reuse
MISSING_ENTRY_EVIDENCE: Exclusive creation/no-overwrite and file/directory durability qualified independently
Bounded claim schema and record publication ownership
STORE_CONTRACT.RETENTION_POLICY: Permanent claim and failure records through all outcomes; archives cannot restore eligibility
STORE_CONTRACT.STORE_OWNER: Future exact approved and qualified controller principal; not owner attestation or invented UID
STORE_CONTRACT.SYMLINK_REJECTION: Reject all path traversal/symlink and caller-writable ancestor aliases; descriptor and mount identity required
